parsed_json.reasoning_summary: The bug is in the update of weight_by_node[v]. The current implementation is incorrect as it tries to update weight_by_node[v] with the minimum of weight_by_node[u] + weight and weight_by_node[v], which is not the correct Bellman-Ford update rule. The correct update rule is weight_by_node[v] = min(weight_by_node[v], weight_by_node[u] + weight).
